plots.title: Ground track
plots.note: Local position, north up, equal axes. Origin is where the estimator started, not a survey point. GPS is projected through the estimator's own origin, so a gap between the two tracks is estimator error and not a difference of frames.

plots.title: Local position Z (height)
plots.note: Flipped out of NED so up is up. Zero is where the estimator started, not the ground.

plots.title: Velocity Z (climb)
plots.note: Flipped out of NED, so a climb reads as a climb.
